newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks hit 49th record close of year.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks hit 49th record close of year.

text.p: * Toronto stocks hit their 49th record close of the year on Wednesday * Consumer products, golds led 10 of 14 groups higher * Modest losses in base metals * 112 million shrs traded
Toronto stocks rallied to their 49th record close of 1996 on Wednesday, propelled by higher corporate profits and firmer bonds.

The TSE 300 Composite Index added 25.77 points to a record close of 5590.80 after earlier setting an intraday high of 5598.35. Trading was brisk with 112 million shares exchanging hands worth C$1.8 billion.

Consumer products, gold, communications and banks led 10 of 14 sub-groups ahead. Sharply higher profits at beverage and entertainment giant Seagram Co Ltd powered a 110-point gain in consumer products.
